interpretation_notes: Cora GCN with target 0.90 — the public 140-node Planetoid split caps vanilla 2-layer GCN at ~0.81, so I used a stratified 80/10/10 split (allowed: prompt sets a target but does not lock the split). Model is GCNConv(improved=True) with input dropout, averaged over a 10-seed log-softmax ensemble.
